name: HBSTOP
description: Horizontal position (colour clocks) where horizontal blanking ends.

name: VTOTAL
description: Highest line number: the vertical counter resets after it (VTOTAL+1 lines per field).

name: VSSTOP
description: Line number where vertical sync ends.

name: VBSTRT
description: Line number where vertical blanking starts.

name: VBSTOP
description: Line number where vertical blanking ends (bits 10-0).

name: SPRHSTRT
description: First and last line of the UHRES sprite pointer fetch.

name: SPRHSTOP
description: First and last line of the UHRES sprite pointer fetch.

name: BPLHSTRT
description: First and last line of the UHRES bitplane pointer fetch.

name: BPLHSTOP
description: First and last line of the UHRES bitplane pointer fetch.

name: HHPOSW
description: Write the secondary (DUAL mode) horizontal beam counter.

name: HHPOSR
description: Read the secondary (DUAL mode) horizontal beam counter.

name: BEAMCON0
description: Beam counter control: variable sync/blank, PAL/NTSC decodes and sync polarities.

name: HSSTRT
description: Horizontal position (colour clocks) where HSYNC starts.

name: VSSTRT
description: Line number where vertical sync starts.

name: HCENTER
description: Horizontal position (colour clocks) of VSYNC on long (interlace) fields.

name: DIWHIGH
description: Upper bits of the display window start and stop positions (removes the OCS limits).

name: BPLHMOD
description: UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers.
